title: At the Doctor
paragraphs: Rafi has had a bad headache and a mild fever since yesterday afternoon. After trying to push through his workday, he finally decides to leave the office early and visit a small clinic near his apartment.
"What seems to be wrong today?" the nurse asks kindly as Rafi sits down across from her. "My head hurts a lot, and I have felt hot and tired since last night," Rafi explains, rubbing his temples.

The nurse gently checks his temperature and asks a few more questions about his symptoms and his week. "You simply need rest, water, and this medicine twice a day," she says, writing a short note for him.

Rafi thanks her and heads home, deciding to finally rest properly instead of ignoring his body's signals like he usually does. Sometimes, he thinks, taking a sick day is the most responsible choice a person can make.
